customManagers.description: Tool versions in docker/<tool>/Dockerfile, declared with a '# renovate:' comment

packageRules.description: A tool bump changes the image tag, so step YAML must be updated in the same PR (make lint enforces it)
prBodyNotes: Update the image tag in every kargo/custom-steps/*/*/*.yaml that uses this image, then run `make step-images` to refresh the step READMEs; `make lint` fails until you do.
